Miasmata is one of my favourites. FPP immersive survival adventure with only one enemy, lots of walking and exploration, interesting concept of mapping based on triangulation, and great story.

Banished is my favourite indie game, it was created and developed by one guy.

It's a medieval city simulation game for PC, it also has a quality modding community. I'd definitely recommend it to anybody.
You already mentioned Spin Tires and KSP, but I also like Zeno Clash. First person brawler with an extremely surreal environment.

ONE FINGER DEATH PUNCH. It's like a buck. Played that game for DAYS.

Copy-pasta'd from a previous post of mine: Dungeons of Fayte is a free PC indie game. Plays like Zelda, but allows 4 players to play at once to squabble over adventuring decisions. 3 can play on your computer RIGHT NOW (1 on mouse, 2 on keyboard). Has almost a dozen classes, four dungeons, and tons of events.

Iji is also a free PC indie game. Plays like a metroidvania mixed with System Shock 2. Where Cave Story relied more on good reflexes, Iji focuses heavy on decision making (Do I sneak up and hack this badguy to be on my side, use this crate as cover, or just go guns-a-blazing?)

Battleships Forever, once again, free indie PC game. Tactics based sci-fi strategy game. Instead of managing economies and bases, you are controlling less than half a dozen ships on a 2d war surface, making them take positions to maximize their efficiency. Your ship with the massive laser cannons can't defend its sides, so you might use your super-agile escort ships to defend it. Or use a stasis field to hold the enemy in place for your long ranged artillery ship to strike. Or use a tractor beam to sling a nearby comet at a bad guy. The decisions are endless! You can even make your own ships with the included shipmaking program.

Exit Fate is a free indie game, plays almost exactly like Suikoden 2. SO FUN. SO HARD.
Many of my favorites are cheap as free. Look up Sonny 1 and 2, Upgrade Complete 1 and 2, Gravitas and RPG Starwish on Kongregate.

Antichamber and Bastion

Bastion is just an all around awesome and satisfying game and Antichamber is … different. Mindwarpingly different even. It’s a great logic/puzzle game and it’s unique in how it takes your expectations and learned behaviors from other games and turns them on their head and inside out without ever violating its own internal logic.
